Brief-claimed-by: session_01Utp6CbQLcy8yg6vhJVXXi8 · batch #426 · 2026-10-29T02:15Z

Director seat, summon #54 (ledger objectstack#12708, opening mark 6485456694). Presented to the maintainer in batch #426 as item 3 of 3, together with #27298 and #27299.

Seat increment (re-read at `origin/main` `73725c20`, 2026-10-29T02:15Z):
- Premises re-run, all hold: `packages/apps/` holds `account`, `setup`, `studio` only (no home for connector apps); ADR-0097 §"Open / enterprise line" with the ADR-0143 amendment note (L125–145) puts static, `oauth2`, `app-credential` and `signed` auth on the open tier, so every app on the E4 list runs on open-tier capabilities; the E4 gates are all open — #26709 (`pm:epic` + `pm:retriage`), #27237 (`pm:dispatched`, p1), #26702 and #26710 (`pm:blocked`, security, p1); no card on the board names a customer asking for a specific connector app.
- Prior rulings: `check-prior-rulings.mjs --card 27302` names ADR-0143 D1 / D3 / D7, ADR-0097 §3, ADR-0023 §4, ADR-0022 §4, ADR-0024 §4 — all about capabilities and contracts; none assigns a listed app to an edition. Thread: the maintainer's three verbatim instructions in the card's filing gate (「连接器先不考虑」 · 「连接器立决策卡」 · 「连接器分开源版和商业版，商业版在 cloud 仓库。」) — the split itself is settled, the dividing rule is the question.
- Facets: agree with the card on ①③; ② and ④ are where the maintainer's own knowledge decides. ① one edition boundary, written in an ADR and mechanically applied (A), beats a second hand-kept list (B, C). ③ under A a misplaced app is detectable (its auth kinds versus the open enum, and `os validate` in this repository's CI); under B or C a misplaced app fails nowhere. ② the pull the seat can measure is zero; the pull the seat cannot measure is the commercial edition's — if the curated catalogue is meant to be what the commercial edition sells, B is the shape that serves it, and the maintainer's 「商业版在 cloud 仓库」 may mean exactly that. ④ B keeps the open repository's permanent maintenance load (vendor API drift, source hashes, licence review) at 3–4 apps instead of 20–30.
- Seat's letter: **A, phased** — the edition follows the ADR-0097/0143 capability line; park now; when E1 (#26709) and E2 (#27237) land, start with only the apps #27293's Done-when needs (DocuSign for the OAuth path plus two or three static-key apps) and grow toward 20–30 on customer pull. The one condition that flips the letter is a business fact only the maintainer holds: if the catalogue itself is the commercial product, rule B and the seat records a hand-kept edition list as a maintained artefact (with its cost named). Not C: the open edition's marketplace would have no reference the E3 recipes can point at.
- Workload of A: `domain:devx` ~3 PRs (one per batch, metadata packages validated by this repository's CI) + 1 `repo:cloud` pipeline card · after E1 + E2 · no precedent. B: devx 1 PR + cloud ~3 PRs. C: cloud ~3 PRs.
- After the ruling: A or B → this card goes `pm:blocked` with `Blocked-by: #26709` and `Blocked-by: #27237`, the epic PM files one card per batch in the ruled repository when both close; C → the cloud seat owns E4 and #27293's E4 row is rewritten.

Prior rulings read: connector app, shelf, official listing, open edition, commercial → ADR-0097 §Open/enterprise line (capabilities only), ADR-0143 D1; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

director#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbQLcy8yg6vhJVXXi8

Ruling: batch #426 item 3 · letter A (phased) · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-29T02:23Z

Director seat, summon #54 (ledger objectstack#12708, opening mark 6485456694, brief 6486036679). The maintainer answered batch #426 in the summon chat with one word, verbatim: 「同意」 — the seat's letter on each of the three cards; for this card **A, phased**. The condition the brief named for B (the curated catalogue itself being the commercial product) was put to the maintainer in the same presentation and not taken up.

**What the ruling binds (letter A, phased):** the edition of an official connector app follows the ADR-0097 / ADR-0143 capability line, mechanically: an app whose every key runs on the open tier is **open edition** and lives in this repository (a metadata package validated by this repository's CI against the runtime at HEAD); an app that needs an enterprise capability (the vault-backed `CredentialResolver`, per-tenant connection lifecycle) or a commercial-only provider is **commercial edition** in the cloud repository. On today's E4 list every app runs on open-tier auth, so the first shelf is open edition. **Timing:** park now; when E1 (#26709) and E2 (#27237) have landed, start with only the apps #27293's Done-when needs — DocuSign for the OAuth path plus two or three static-key apps — and grow toward 20–30 on customer pull, batch by batch (static-key; OAuth after #26702; signature after #26710). Ingestion and listing generation stay with the cloud repository as #27293 assigns them. Not taken: B (a second, hand-kept edition list beside the ADR line; a misplaced app fails nowhere), C (the open edition's marketplace with no reference the E3 recipes can point at).

Governing text: ADR-0097 §"Open / enterprise line" as amended by ADR-0143 (capabilities); the maintainer's 2026-10-28 instructions quoted in this card's filing gate (the split itself); #27293 E4 row and Done-when. Premises re-read at `origin/main` `73725c20` (brief 6486036679).

**Workload of the letter:** `domain:devx` ~3 PRs (one per batch, metadata packages) + 1 `repo:cloud` pipeline card · after E1 + E2 · no precedent.

**Execution:** this card moves `needs-user-decision` → `pm:blocked` in this act with `Blocked-by: #26709` and `Blocked-by: #27237` (body and thread); `pm:epic` stays. When both close, the epic PM of #27293 files one card per batch as sub-issues of #27293 in this repository, plus the pipeline card in the cloud repository, each citing this comment on a `Ruling-ref:` line; #27293's E4 row is updated by the epic PM to this ruling.

os-decision-facets
① 长远：开源与商业只有一条边界且写在 ADR 里，按应用所需能力机械归版，不新增第二份手工名单
② 拉动：板上无客户点名；先停到 E1/E2 落地，首批只做验收所需，再按拉动增长
③ 防错：归版判据可机械判定，放错仓可被检查出来；开源仓内应用在同一 CI 里过 `os validate`
④ 不扩散：分期把开源仓的永久维护义务压到首批 3–4 个应用，20–30 只随拉动增长
